name: pixeltable
description: Multimodal RAG, video search, image similarity search, agent memory, and embeddings stored with your data. Declarative tables, computed columns, retrieval, agents, and HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Multimodal RAG, video/image/audio search, and agent memory in one file
interface.longDescription: Multimodal RAG over PDFs, images, and video; video search; image similarity search; embeddings stored with your data; audio transcription search; agent memory; incremental pipelines; dataset versioning. Tables, computed columns, embedding indexes, tool-calling agents, and the pxt CLI (schema, service, inspect).
defaultPrompt: Index my video library and make it searchable
Add RAG over my PDFs and images
Give my AI agent long-term memory across sessions
